w0=W['ln1_w.0']
def heads(l):
    w=W[f'ln1_w.{l}']
    res=[]

        s=slice(j*64,(j+1)*64)

        res.append((q,k,v,o))

H=[heads(l) for l in range(4)]

        q,k,v,o=H[l][j]

        ev=ev[np.argsort(-np.abs(ev))]
